The endoplasmic reticulum (ER), in particular, is a major site for protein production and quality control in membrane and secretory systems.

HSP70 is the most abundant chaperone and exists as many orthologues in different cellular compartments. In association with various cofactors it carries out diverse functions, including protein folding, trans location across organelle membranes and disaggregation of aggregates.
